correctness.rationale: The rule depends only on center color c and exact set S of occupied leaf colors, yielding exactly 3(2³−1)=21 support states and exact deterministic support-map Φ. I independently rebuilt all 21 transitions and their first hitting times (0..6 or never), finding only (2,{0,1,2}) nonsynchronizing. For any r, a support set of size j represents precisely U1=1, U2=2^r−2 or U3=3^r−3·2^r+3 surjective assignments of labelled leaves. Weighting the 21 support states by their first-hit times proves every histogram entry and total 3^{r+1}, with r=1 boundary sharp maximum three and r≥2 sharp maximum six. Independent direct full labelled-state simulations for r=1..7 agreed with the claimed counts, including ∞. As r→∞, times 5,6,∞ each have proportion 1/3. The all-r proof is the complete finite state quotient, not an extrapolated enumeration.
